newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Partners to build Georgia homes.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Partners to build Georgia homes.

text.p: Heartland Partners LP said Wednesday it signed a perviously announced agreement to become the exclusive homebuilder for Osprey Cove Inc, a real estate development affiliate of Gilman Paper Co.

Heartland Partners said it will build about 300 homes in the 550-unit Osprey Cove master-planned community in St. Mary's, Georgia, about 40 miles north of Jacksonville, Florida. The homes will be priced between $150,000 and $400,000, the company said.
Heartland Partners is a real estate partnership with properties in 13 states.
